summary: The core, breadth, WIM and capstone courses must be letter graded; research units need not be. You take the six foundation courses, 27 units of electives with at most 9 outside EPS, 6 units of research in EPS 192 or 197, EPS 150 for Writing in the Major, and 3 units of EPS 190 or EPS 193 for the capstone (repeat enrollments count), for 60 units. Your advisor checks the 2.0 GPA, approval of a self-designed capstone, and transfer credit (at most 10 units). Honors adds 9 units of EPS 199, a 3.0 GPA, and a report approved by two readers and presented. Left: the Bulletin calls the foundation 21 units, but its six courses carry 20 in the catalog, so the minimum in every rule comes to 59 and the audit asks for one more unit toward the 60.
